deck.title: Emoji Pop Joy — pop. smile. repeat.

slides.notes: Open light: this is a thirty-second toy, not a pitch for a platform. Say the tagline out loud — pop, smile, repeat.

props.label: The idea
props.text: Not every game needs a quest. Some just need to be a **thirty-second mood lift** — a screen full of bouncing emojis and one simple pleasure: pop them.

slides.notes: Land the thesis: no story, no grind, no pressure. The whole point is a small burst of delight when you need one.

items.title: Emojis float and bounce
items.body: The screen fills with gently drifting emojis.

items.title: Tap or click to pop
items.body: Each pop lands with a satisfying burst.

items.title: Combos and gentle escalation
items.body: Things speed up playfully — lively, never stressful.

slides.notes: Walk the one interaction loop. Emphasise the last step: escalation is a giggle, not a difficulty curve.

slides.notes: Skim, don't read. The features are deliberately small — the value is how little there is to learn.
